description: This bar chart illustrates the win, tie, and loss rates for two models, GPT40 and Doubao, in a series of interactions. The horizontal axis represents the outcome categories—Win, Tie, and Lose—and is labeled accordingly, with values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The vertical axis lists the model names, GPT40 and Doubao, in that order. Each model is represented by a set of three stacked bars, one for each outcome category, with pink representing “Win”, light blue representing “Tie”, and light green representing “Lose”. For GPT40, the “Win” bar reaches approximately 56.0%, the “Tie” bar reaches approximately 18.0%, and the “Lose” bar reaches approximately 26.0%. For Doubao, the “Win” bar reaches approximately 42.0%, the “Tie” bar reaches approximately 36.0%, and the “Lose” bar reaches approximately 22.0%. The bars are stacked to show the total percentage for each model, and a legend clarifies the color coding for each outcome. No bars are visually emphasized.
